# Jarby Jessid Cosme

> Software and AI engineer based in Cali, Colombia (GMT-5). Builds and runs production RAG systems. Sole technical owner of the AI support platform at SIESA, a Colombian ERP company. Also known as Jessid Cosme. Open to full-time remote roles.

## Profile
- Name: Jarby Jessid Cosme (also: Jessid Cosme, Jarby Cosme)
- Role: Software and AI Engineer at SIESA (since March 2022)
- Also described as: AI Engineer, Software Engineer, LLM Engineer, RAG Engineer, Backend Engineer (.NET, Python), Ingeniero de software e IA, Ingeniero de IA, Ingeniero de software
- Location: Cali, Colombia
- Focus: retrieval-augmented generation, LLM evaluation (LLM-as-judge), AWS Bedrock, PostgreSQL + pgvector, LangGraph, Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript
- Education: Technologist in Systems Analysis and Development (SENA, 2022); B.Sc. Systems Engineering, UNAD (in progress)

## Public work
- [rag-eval-bench](https://github.com/JessidC/rag-eval-bench): release gate for RAG changes on the Odoo 18 docs (golden set, LLM-as-judge, citation and number validator, McNemar test in GitHub Actions). Hybrid retrieval beat dense by 12.5 points; 9.7 and not significant with a judge from another model family.
- [support-learning-loop](https://github.com/JessidC/support-learning-loop): public rebuild of a support improvement loop on the ABCD dataset. Correctly resolved chats went from 19% to 59% on 330 held-out chats.
- [enterprise-fullstack-dotnet](https://github.com/JessidC/enterprise-fullstack-dotnet): .NET 8 and React reference monorepo
- [Tocaturno](https://tocaturno.com): WhatsApp reception SaaS in production for appointment-based businesses. Founded and built by Jarby.
